_comment: BeeSky watch/notify config example — copy to notify.json and edit. Mirrors EMCD Monitoring's settings matrix (per event: channels + threshold), plus the webhook channel EMCD lacks. Thresholds use EMCD's scales: detection floor 5% / 5 C, severity steps 15/30/50% and 10/20/30 C.

telegram._comment_creds: bot_token/chat_id may instead come from env BEESKY_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / BEESKY_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. api_base is overridable for testing.

webhook._comment_url: Any HTTP endpoint. The event is POSTed as JSON. Point it at Home Assistant / a relay controller to switch exhaust fans or water-mist pumps on OVER_TEMP, for example.
